item.title: Local Wilmington resident gets to enjoy hobbies again after seeing Low Vision Optometrist
item.description: February is Low Vision Awareness month, and millions of Americans suffer because of it. One local resident now enjoys life better after getting new device for his glasses.

item.title: NHCO Community Justice Center seeks community support as $5M grant expires
item.description: It’s been over one year since the New Hanover County Community Justice Center opened its doors. The organization aims to be a one-stop shop for victims of crime.

item.title: Wilmington to continue joint operation with NHCO of forensic lab
item.description: The city of Wilmington has approved an agreement with New Hanover County to continue joint operation of a forensic lab.

item.title: Testimony continues in case against Pender County Clerk
item.description: More witnesses took the stand Thursday in the trial of current Pender County Clerk of Court, Elizabeth Craver.

item.title: Fourth graders step back in time at Battle of Moores Creek Bridge reenactment
item.description: It's been nearly 250 years since the Battle of Moores Creek Bridge, and on Thursday, groups of 4th graders had the opportunity to learn about this part of local history.

item.title: Netflix walks away from Warner Bros deal, clearing the path for Paramount
item.description: Netflix is walking away from its offer to buy Warner Bros. Discovery’s studio and streaming business, in a stunning move that effectively puts Paramount in a position to take over its storied Hollywood rival.

item.title: Columbia student detained by ICE is abruptly released after Mamdani meets with Trump
item.description: Federal immigration authorities arrested a Columbia University student early Thursday, triggering protests on campus and allegations that agents gained entry to the university-owned residence by posing as police officers searching for a missing child.

item.title: UNCW blows out North Carolina A&T 88-65
item.description: It was a big night for a lot of reasons for UNCW men's basketball, and it's all thanks to their 88-65 home win over North Carolina A&T on Thursday.

item.title: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers responds to Wilmington Dredging objections by NCDEQ
item.description: The project would dredge the harbor and channel leading into the port of Wilmington, allowing larger ships that would make the port more competitive with other ports like Norfolk and Charleston.

item.title: A look at the Wilmington Marathon’s economic impact on the Cape Fear region
item.description: Thousands of runners will methodically make their way towards downtown Wilmington.
